info.name: digiQC - Health Check API
info.description: Collection for testing and monitoring the health check endpoints (/health and /api/health) of the digiQC backend.

request.description: Checks whether the backend server is on/off, operational, and whether vital services like PostgreSQL are connected. If on and healthy, returns HTTP 200 with success message. If degraded/off, returns HTTP 503 with the detailed failure reason.

response.name: 200 Healthy Response
503 Degraded/Offline Service Response
